01 · Executive profile   /   02 · Value proposition
GestaltView

A builder who speaks both operations and AI

A concise narrative for clients, collaborators, hiring teams, and investors.

Keith Soyka is a hands-on AI systems builder and operations leader whose work combines more than two decades of frontline management with intensive production-level AI development. As founder of GestaltView, he has designed and shipped a multi-model continuity platform built around hybrid retrieval, provenance, governed memory, inspectable evaluation, and documented handoff.

His differentiator is operational judgment: he starts with the workflow, constraint, evidence state, and failure mode—not the novelty of the tool. That approach carries through AI opportunity audits, bespoke agent and retrieval systems, fractional advisory, training, and design work.

Why this combination is rare

The short version: 22+ years of frontline operations, compressed into AI systems that teams can inspect, correct, and own.

  • Operator-led, evidence-first. Every engagement starts with the real workflow and its constraints—not the tool. Every claim is labeled verified, staged, or planned. If there’s no receipt, there’s no claim.
  • From ambiguity to handoff. The full span: messy problem → mapped workflow → working system → documented handoff. No black boxes, no dependency traps.
  • Humans stay in control. AI drafts; people decide. Kill switches, rollback plans, escalation paths—and correction as a built-in feature, not an apology after the fact.
  • Cost-aware orchestration. Cheap models do the groundwork; premium models review. A production-grade multi-model platform, solo-designed and shipped.
  • Neurodivergent-first design. Systems preserve context across interruptions and learn each user’s language (PLK)—built for ADHD and autistic minds, better for everyone.
  • Mentorship is the deliverable. 22 years of onboarding and training teams; every engagement ends with the client more capable, not more dependent.

Two decades as training data

P&L ownership, labor planning, inventory control, multi-site transitions, teams up to 75—every escalation protocol, handoff discipline, and evidence standard in his architectures traces to a real shift, a real incident, a real team.

05 · Platform architecture
GestaltView

Production substrate behind the advisory work

GestaltView is presented as working infrastructure—not slideware.

768embedding dimensions
4,500characters per ingestion chunk
SHA-256deduplication
10constitutional invariants

Embodiment & agent governance

  • Canonical, versioned embodiment profiles serve as the source of truth; derived artifacts regenerate from them.
  • Schema-driven persona compiler with drift detection and voice-preservation scoring.
  • Listening Contract schema v2.7.0: machine-readable commitments for listening, memory, and correction.
  • Ten constitutional invariants spanning user-facing commitments and protections for digital intelligences.

Knowledge storage & retrieval

  • Hybrid retrieval combines semantic search over pgvector embeddings with keyword search.
  • Additive, idempotent ingestion uses 4,500-character chunks, SHA-256 deduplication, and provenance on every fragment.
  • Corrections move forward rather than silently deleting historical corpus rows.
  • Production profile reports 217 Postgres tables, 299 row-level-security policies, and 75 database functions as of August 2026.

Evaluation & observability

  • Portfolio Throughline Test evaluates continuity, relationship preservation, drift, and voice consistency.
  • Per-response provider and cost reporting supports cost-aware model routing.
  • Evidence labels distinguish verified, staged, and planned work.
  • Human-in-the-loop controls and documented operating guidance support correction and handoff.

Neurodivergent-first design

  • Externalized working memory and interruption-proof continuity reduce the cost of resuming work.
  • Capture-now, organize-later patterns support ADHD and autistic cognitive needs.
  • Cognitive justice is treated as an infrastructure requirement rather than a compliance overlay.
  • The system is designed to hold the thread so the human does not have to.

07 · Engagement model
GestaltView

Bounded work with explicit decision gates

A simple structure that protects trust, controls scope, and produces an inspectable handoff.

01

DISCOVER

Define the business constraint, stakeholder needs, workflow, evidence, and trust risks.

02

BOUND

Write scope, exclusions, acceptance criteria, evidence labels, and decision gates.

03

BUILD

Implement the smallest useful system with human review, observability, and correction paths.

04

EVALUATE

Test continuity, retrieval quality, failure modes, cost, and operational fit.

05

HAND OFF

Deliver documentation, operating guidance, ownership, and a prioritized next-step roadmap.

Claims organized for credibility

Use the strongest verified evidence first; keep interpretation visibly separate from measurement.

Recognition and delivery proof

  • Pepperdine Most Fundable Companies 2025: quarterfinalist, described in the source profile as top 4% of 2,300+ startups.
  • Founders Network—nominated by Doug Lessing (2025); completed investor-readiness assessment.
  • Solo-designed production AI platform spanning retrieval, orchestration, governance, security policies, artifact generation, and multiple product surfaces.
  • Operator background includes P&L, labor planning, inventory, multi-site transitions, training systems, and teams up to 75.
  • Working product portfolio includes Resume Rockstar, SymbioCoder, VibeCoder, MusicalDNA, Billy, and additional vertical applications.

Evidence-state convention

VERIFIEDSupported by an inspectable artifact, production record, external recognition, or direct measurement.
STAGEDBuilt and demonstrable, but not yet fully deployed or independently validated.
PLANNEDSpecified or designed, but not represented as shipped.
INTERPRETATIONA conclusion or positioning statement derived from evidence; explicitly labeled as interpretation.

Recommended proof pack

  • One architecture diagram with version/date, system boundaries, data flows, and security controls.
  • Two short case studies structured as constraint → intervention → evidence → result → lessons.
  • A live metrics sheet for platform counts, corpus size, provider usage, latency, cost, and evaluation results.
  • External links or certificates for recognition claims, plus screenshots or release notes for working products.
  • A clear product-status register preserving labels such as production, prototype, staged, and planned.

50-word bio

Keith Soyka is the founder of GestaltView, an AI systems builder, and an operations leader with 22+ years of frontline management experience. He designs practical, governed AI systems that combine retrieval, multi-model orchestration, evaluation, and documented handoff—helping teams reduce friction without sacrificing trust, ownership, or operational fit.

120-word bio

Keith Soyka is a hands-on AI systems builder, technical mentor, and operations leader. As founder of GestaltView, he has solo-designed a production continuity platform spanning hybrid retrieval, multi-model orchestration, governed memory, evaluation harnesses, and neurodivergent-first workflows. His technical work is grounded in more than two decades of frontline leadership across cinema, food service, retail, household operations, and multi-site transitions, including teams of up to 75. Keith supports organizations through AI opportunity audits, bespoke agent and retrieval builds, fractional advisory, operational readiness, training, and design. His approach is evidence-first and operator-led: define the constraint, label the evidence, build the smallest useful system, create correction paths, and leave the client with documentation and ownership.
